verdict.rationale: Gitea explicitly supports webhooks and API extensibility for custom CI/CD workflows, and real-world community usage confirms pairing Gitea with external CI tools like Drone instead of (or alongside) native Gitea Actions, across multiple long-term users. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation/integration guides for specific external CI tools (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, Drone) and no independent benchmarking of webhook-based CI triggering.
